failure_meanings.identity_unavailable: The process on the API lane is not exposing the owned MCP Factory API contract.
failure_meanings.identity_role_mismatch: The process on the API lane is not the pipeline control plane.
failure_meanings.readiness_unavailable: The API is present but not publishing explicit readiness.
failure_meanings.bridge_not_ready: The API cannot safely execute local runs because its bridge dependency is not ready.

failure_meanings.identity_unavailable: The process on the bridge lane is not exposing the owned MCP Factory bridge contract.
failure_meanings.identity_capabilities_incomplete: The bridge is missing required execution or cache-reset capability.
failure_meanings.readiness_unavailable: The bridge is present but not publishing explicit readiness.
failure_meanings.bridge_secret_missing: The bridge process does not have a configured shared secret, so execution trust is red.

failure_meanings.canary_verdict_failed: The bounded lane-trust floor failed and the managed local lane should not steer a broader local run.
failure_meanings.packet_missing: The proving runner did not emit one or more required trust artifacts.
failure_meanings.api_identity_invalid: The runner did not observe a trustworthy API identity on the managed lane.
failure_meanings.bridge_identity_invalid: The runner did not observe a trustworthy bridge identity on the managed lane.
failure_meanings.analyze_only_failed: The lane could not complete the deterministic analyze-only trust check for the canonical canary DLL.
failure_meanings.bridge_execution_failed: The bridge could not complete the bounded cache-reset execution canary.
